titleLines: Pre- and post-operative physical therapy for cosmetic and reconstructive surgery
hero.text: Appointments in Lyon 1, near the Opera, and in Lyon 5, Point du Jour district.

myApproach.title: MY APPROACH TO CARE
myApproach.p1: I have been a physical therapist since 2012. For several years, I worked with elite athletes, including the German national artistic gymnastics team. It taught me high standards of care, the habit of working as a team with surgeons and doctors, and the conviction that every treatment plan must start from the person: their history, their body, their goals.
myApproach.p2: I welcome you in a calm and warm setting, where I take the time to listen to you. My commitment is to support you with kindness and effectiveness towards your goals.

drainage.title: Lymphatic drainage
drainage.text: Therapeutic drainage adapted to your tissues for lipedema or other venous or lymphatic conditions, or Renata França wellness drainage for a feeling of lightness and smoother skin.

postOp.title: Pre- and post-operative physical therapy for cosmetic and reconstructive surgery
postOp.text: Assessment before and after the operation, adapted drainage, taping, scar work and a gradual return to movement, in coordination with your surgeon.
postOp.alt: Pre-operative markings drawn by the surgeon before cosmetic surgery

postPartum.title: Postpartum abdominal rehabilitation
postPartum.text: Diastasis, overall strengthening, hypopressive abs and Pilates, from the first weeks after giving birth until you return to sport. In Lyon 5 and online.

soon.text: Photobiomodulation (LED) from late November, then LPG: alongside your post-operative care or as a wellness treatment.
